defaults.treatment: Kasallikni erta aniqlash muhim. Bargini yuvib, yaxshi shamollatish va ehtiyotkor pestitsid ishlatish kerak. Oqibatda qoldiq qolgan barglarni yo‘q qiling.
defaults.prevention: Bargni yumshoq, sog‘lom va quyoshli joyda saqlang. Sug‘orish va ventilyatsiyani tekshiring.

Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Barglarni tekshirib, kasal qismlarni olib tashlang. Molyar, sulfat yoki tavsiya qilingan fungitsid bilan ishlov berish kerak. Suv va havo aylanishini yaxshilang.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Barglarni quruq qolgan holda sug‘ormang, daraxt oralig‘ini havo aylanishi uchun bo‘sh qoldiring.

Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Kasallangan mevalar, shox va barglarni darhol kesib olib tashlang va yoqib yuboring. Kurtak yorishidan oldin mis asosidagi (bordo suyuqligi) fungitsid bilan ishlov bering.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Daraxt tagini yiqilgan barg va chirigan mevalardan tozalab turing, shoxlarni kesib havo aylanishini yaxshilang.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Kasal barglarni yig‘ib yo‘q qiling, gullash davridan boshlab tavsiya etilgan fungitsid bilan profilaktik ishlov bering.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Yaqin atrofdagi archa (juniper) daraxtlaridan uzoqroqqa eking — kasallik shu ikki o‘simlik orasida almashib turadi.

Apple___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Daraxtni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Muntazam sug‘oring, kuzda tushgan barglarni yig‘ishtirib, shoxlarni har yili shakllantirib turing.

Blueberry___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Butani odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Tuproq kislotali (pH 4.5–5.5) bo‘lishini kuzating, tomchilatib sug‘oring.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Daraxtni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Har yili shox kesish orqali toj ichini shamollatib turing.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Kasallangan barg va yosh novdalarni kesib tashlang, oltingugurt asosidagi yoki tavsiya etilgan fungitsid bilan ishlov bering.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Daraxt tojini siyraklashtirib havo aylanishini yaxshilang, ortiqcha azotli o‘g‘itlardan saqlaning.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Kasallangan barglarni yig‘ishtirib yoqing, kuchli yuqishda tavsiya etilgan fungitsid qo‘llang.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Ekinlarni almashlab eking, o‘simlik qoldiqlarini yerga chuqur haydang, chidamli navlarni tanlang.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Zang belgilari ko‘ringan barglarni kuzatib boring, kuchli yuqishda fungitsid qo‘llang.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Chidamli navlar eking, dala shamollashini yaxshilash uchun ekish zichligini nazorat qiling.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Ekinni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Almashlab ekish qoidalariga rioya qiling, dalani begona o‘tlardan tozalang.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Kasal barglarni olib tashlang. Fungitsid bilan ishlov berish maqsadga muvofiq. Dala qoldiqlarini yo‘q qiling.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Dala orasini yaxshi shamollatib, sug‘orishni nazorat qiling.

Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Kasal novdalarni olib tashlang, shikastlangan mevalarni to‘plang. Fungitsid bilan ishlov berish kerak. O‘simlikni yaxshi shamollatib turing.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Yomg‘ir suvi bargga uzoq vaqt tegib turmasligiga e’tibor bering. Havo aylanishini yaxshilang.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: Kasallangan tana qismlarini kesib olib tashlang, kesim joyini himoya vositasi bilan yoping. Og‘ir zararlangan tokni yulib tashlash kerak bo‘lishi mumkin.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Kesish paytida asboblarni dezinfeksiya qiling, tok tanasidagi jarohatlarni kamaytiring.

Grape___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Tokni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Har yili kesish orqali tokzorni shamollatib turing, ortiqcha bargni kamaytiring.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Kasal barglarni yig‘ib yoqing, mis asosidagi fungitsid bilan ishlov bering.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Tok orasini siyraklab, havo aylanishini yaxshilang, yer yaqinidagi barglarni kesib tashlang.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: Bu kasallikka hozircha to‘liq davo yo‘q. Kasallangan daraxtni butunlay yulib, yoqib yo‘q qilish kerak — aks holda boshqa daraxtlarga tez yuqadi.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Kasallikni tarqatuvchi sitrus psillasi hashorotiga qarshi kurashing, faqat ishonchli manbadan sog‘lom ko‘chat oling.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Kasal barg va mevalarni yig‘ib yoqing, mis asosidagi bakteritsid bilan ishlov bering.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Bargni sug‘organda suv tegizmang, daraxtlar orasidagi masofani ko‘paytirib havo aylanishini yaxshilang.

Peach___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Daraxtni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Peach___healthy.prevention: Har yili shox kesib toj ichini shamollatib turing, tushgan barglarni yig‘ishtiring.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Kasal barglarni yig‘ib yo‘q qiling, mis asosidagi preparat bilan ishlov bering, kasal ko‘chatlarni alohida parvarish qiling.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Urug‘/ko‘chatni ishonchli manbadan oling, sug‘organda barglarni ho‘llamang, ekinlarni almashlab eking.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. O‘simlikni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Me’yorida sug‘oring, tuvakni/dalani begona o‘tlardan tozalang.

Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Kasal pastki barglarni darhol olib tashlang, tavsiya etilgan fungitsid bilan ishlov bering.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Ekinlarni almashlab eking, hosildan keyin dala qoldiqlarini yo‘q qiling, o‘simliklar orasida yetarli masofa qoldiring.

Potato___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Ekinni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Sog‘lom urug‘lik tuber ishlating, tuproqni haddan tashqari namlamang.

Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Kasal tomirlar va barglarni olib tashlang. Mavjud fungitsid bilan davolashni davom eting. To‘g‘ri sug‘orish tartibiga rioya qiling.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Tuproqni quruq saqlang, sug‘orishni kechqurun qiling va dalani havo aylanishi uchun bo‘sh qoldiring.

Raspberry___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Butani odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Eski novdalarni hosildan keyin kesib tashlang, qator orasini shamollatib turing.

Soybean___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. Ekinni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Almashlab ekish qoidalariga amal qiling, dalani begona o‘tlardan tozalang.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Kasal barglarni kesib tashlang, oltingugurt yoki tavsiya etilgan fungitsid bilan ishlov bering.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: O‘simliklar orasida yetarli masofa qoldiring, yuqoridan sug‘organda barglarni ho‘llashdan saqlaning.

Strawberry___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. O‘simlikni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Muntazam sug‘oring, barglarni kuzatib boring va dalani toza saqlang.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Kasal barglarni kesib olib tashlang, hosildan keyin eski barglarni yig‘ishtiring.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Yetarli masofada eking, tomchilatib sug‘orishdan foydalaning, havo aylanishini yaxshilang.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Kasal barglarni yig‘ib yoqing, mis asosidagi bakteritsid bilan ishlov bering.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Sog‘lom urug‘/ko‘chat ishlating, barglarni ho‘llamasdan tomchilatib sug‘oring, ekinlarni almashlab eking.

Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Barglarning pastki qismini olib tashlang. Yer osti qismida namlikni kamaytirish uchun sug‘orish vaqtini kechga o‘tkazing. Fungitsid ishlatishingiz mumkin.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: O‘simliklarni yupqa, yetarlicha oraliqda eking. Namlik va shilimshiqlikni kamaytiring.

Tomato___healthy.treatment: Kasallik belgisi topilmadi. O‘simlikni odatdagi parvarishda davom ettiring.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Me’yorida sug‘oring, barglarni kuzating va dalani toza saqlang.

Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Kasal barg va mevalarni olib tashlang. O‘simlikni ruxsat etilgan fungitsid bilan ishlang. Suvning bargga tegib qolmasligi uchun tomchilatib sug‘orishdan foydalaning.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Yomg‘irdan keyin barglar quriguncha kutib, havo aylanishini yaxshilang.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Kasal barglarni olib tashlang, issiqxonada namlikni kamaytiring, tavsiya etilgan fungitsid qo‘llang.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Issiqxonani muntazam shamollating, o‘simliklar orasida bo‘sh joy qoldiring.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Kasal pastki barglarni darhol olib tashlang, fungitsid bilan ishlov bering.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Sug‘organda barglarga suv tegizmang, ekin qoldiqlarini yig‘ishtirib yo‘q qiling.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Barglar orqasini tekshirib, akaritsid yoki sovunli suv eritmasi bilan ishlov bering, kuchli zararlanishda kasal barglarni kesib tashlang.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Havo namligini oshirib turing (o‘rgimchakkana quruq havoni yoqtiradi), o‘simlikni muntazam kuzatib boring.

Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Kasal barglarni olib tashlang, tavsiya etilgan fungitsid bilan davolang.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Ekinlar orasidagi masofani kattalashtiring, havo aylanishini yaxshilang.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: Virusga qarshi davo yo‘q — kasallangan tuplarni yulib oling, boshqa o‘simliklarga yuqmasligi uchun yoqib yuboring.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Ish vositalarini dezinfeksiya qiling, tamaki bilan ishlagandan keyin qo‘l yuving (virus shu orqali ham yuqadi), chidamli navlar eking.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: Davo yo‘q — kasallangan tuplarni yulib tashlang, virusni tarqatuvchi oq qanotli hasharotga (bo‘z pashsha) qarshi kurashing.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Ko‘chatlarni ekishdan oldin tekshiring, oq qanotli hasharotlarga qarshi tur to‘ri yoki tavsiya etilgan insektitsid qo‘llang.
